events.title: French Economy Shrinks More Than Estimated; Inflation Moderates
events.description: The French economy contracted more than estimated in the third quarter, revised data from the statistical office INSEE showed Friday. Gross domestic product shrank 0.2 percent after remaining flat in the preceding period. The decline for the third quarter was revised down from -0.1 percent.

events.title: Pound Rises Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: Indian Shares Tumble As IT, Financials Drag
events.description: Indian shares tumbled on Friday despite firm cues from other Asian and European markets.

events.title: Gold Rallies On Softer Dollar, Tech Rebound
events.description: Gold prices rallied on Friday, recovering from their lowest levels since August 2025, due to a softer dollar and improving technology sentiment.

events.title: Oil Set For Weekly Gain Amid Gulf Attacks
events.description: Oil prices traded higher on Friday and remained on track for their first weekly gain this month due to rising attacks on energy infrastructure in the Middle East and vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: European Shares Extend Rally As AI Jitters Ease, Metal Prices Recover
events.description: European stocks surged on Friday, extending sharp gains from the previous session, led by mining and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Shares Rally On Hopes Of Policy Support
events.description: Asian stocks advanced on Friday after South Korea and Beijing signaled more support to stabilize their stock markets. Tech stocks soared after recent volatility amid a market holiday on Wall Street for Thanksgiving.

events.title: Antipodean Currencies Rise Amid Risk-On Mood
events.description: The antipodean currencies such as the Australia and the New Zealand dollars strengthened against their major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as Asian stock markets traded higher as traders return to buy semiconductor and technology stocks on stabilized sentiment over AI trade following a sharp sell-off earlier in the week. They also stepped in to pick up recently beaten-down shares.

events.title: NZ Dollar Advances Against Most Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against most major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: European Shares Poised To Open Higher
events.description: European stocks are set to open on a firm note on Friday despite long-term anxieties surrounding the AI trade, lingering Middle East tensions and expectations for higher-for-longer interest rates.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Lower In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were modestly lower in early trade on Friday as global technology stocks stabilized after recent string of losses and a strike on an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia's southern Jazan region heightened concerns over supply disruptions from the Middle East.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early gains in mid-market moves on Friday after opening slightly in the red, adding to the gains in the previous session, following the positive cues from European markets and lack of cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving above the 8,800 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining, energy and technology stocks.
